title: Geertruidenberg on the horizon
summary: The power plant in Geertruidenberg on the skyline, seen through a long lens over an autumn forest in a grey haze.
content:
The power plant in Geertruidenberg on the skyline, seen through a long lens over an autumn forest in a grey haze. The further away, the less there is to see, and the more you want to know what is out there.

Sony RX10 V · f/4 · 1/4 s · ISO 100
